# LINKSUPPLIED

> LINKSUPPLIED is an industrial B2B discovery, intelligence, and capability-matching platform for procurement teams and manufacturers.

## What LINKSUPPLIED does

LINKSUPPLIED helps procurement teams identify manufacturing partners that fit specific engineering requirements. Buyers submit structured requirements such as process, material, tolerance, batch size, and delivery needs. LINKSUPPLIED then presents relevant supplier capabilities together with verification evidence and explainable match criteria.

For manufacturers, LINKSUPPLIED provides a way to be discovered for the machinery, certifications, capacity, and technical capabilities they actually operate.

## Important distinction

LINKSUPPLIED is not an industrial electrical-components seller, a generic link directory, a reseller supplier-list service, or a company named "Link Supply." It is a web-based platform for industrial B2B procurement and manufacturing capability matching.

## Core concepts

- Structured industrial sourcing and RFQ workflows
- Manufacturing capability discovery
- Evidence-backed supplier verification
- Explainable matching between engineering requirements and supplier capabilities
- Direct buyer-to-manufacturer commercial connections
